description: This file defines the 'KeyHandler' class responsible for creating, reading, and managing cryptographic keys within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods for generating new keys, reading existing keys, and checking for their existence, with exception handling for various error conditions.

classes.name: KeyHandler
classes.description: A utility class for generating, reading, and managing cryptographic keys used within the system.

methods.name: createKey
methods.description: Generates a new cryptographic key, saves it to a designated path, and handles exceptions if the key already exists or if an error occurs during creation.

methods.name: readKey
methods.description: Reads the existing cryptographic key from the filesystem, with exception handling for non-existence, unreadability, and caching the key for subsequent calls.

methods.name: keyExists
methods.description: Checks if the key file exists at the specified path.

methods.name: getRealPathToKey
methods.description: Returns the absolute path to the key file if it exists, otherwise null.

methods.name: getPathToKey
methods.description: Constructs and returns the filepath to the key file based on configuration settings.
